findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed a coffee pot to be resting in hand sink. Discussed with PIC, pot was relocated. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer bucket to be at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, bucket was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available at the proper concentration level during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Observed no active sani bucket during the inspection. Employee was using a bucket of soap and water, no sanitizer bucket was present. Discussed with PIC and employee. Ensure staff is aware to make sanitizer buckets prior to starting service. Employee made a sanitizer bucket upon request. 400 ppm. Facility has quat test strips to verify concentration. Change sanitizer buckets as needed to maintain 200-400 ppm of concentration. COS.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands then use their bare hand to turn off the faucet. Education took place to correct. PIC is instructed to ensure that employees wash hand correctly at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

On arrival, the sani bucket registered approximately 10 ppm free CL in solution. Bucket was remade to approximately 200 ppm on inspector’s test strips.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

The mop is observed stored in the mop bucket with dirty water. Pic instructed to store mop so that it hangs/drys effectively. Mop water changed during inspection to correct.


6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

Acoustic ceiling tiles are observed: 1) above the donut service areas, 2) in the bathrooms, 3) above the 3 part sink. The ceiling tiles should be made of materials that are smooth and easily cleanable as well as well unlikely to produce falling particles/pieces. PIC instructed to replace prior to the next routine inspection.
